origin: Own exact deterministic four-compartment chemostatted chemical kinetic model, motivated by the Brusselator. Concentrations, controls and time are dimensionless. The flux calibration is a constructed noiseless oracle, not a real chemical measurement, and no empirical reactor validation is claimed.
chemical_model: Each compartment has the idealized driven reactions A->X at fluxA, B+X->Y+D at fluxB*X, 2X+Y->3X at fluxX^2*Y, and X->E at fluxX. Feed activities A=1 and variableB are externally fixed; D and E are removed. Thus reaction vector F(X,Y)=[1-(B+1)X+X^2Y,BX-X^2Y]. These irreversible chemostatted equations do not define a closed equilibrium thermodynamic system or a free energy minimum. Four equal compartments1,2,3,4 form the undirected unit-weight ring edges12,23,34,41. Each species has nearest-neighbor diffusive transfer with a common unknown positive coefficient for that species; no cross diffusion. Let L be the UNNORMALIZED graph Laplacian. The complete8-dimensional ODE in interleaved order[X1,Y1,X2,Y2,X3,Y3,X4,Y4] is dot(c_i)=F(c_i)-diag(DX,DY)*sum_j L_ij*c_j.
transport_identification: The CSV gives signed isolated-bond calibration pairs: oriented fluxX=DX*deltaX and fluxY=DY*deltaY, with all differences in the same orientation. Use all three rows and actual LinearLeastSquares for the complete coupled6-row design in the two unknown transport coefficients, not a ratio from one convenient row. Retain actual GraphLaplacian of the full adjacency and actual SymmetricEigenDecomposition of that returned L, including every eigenvalue and multiplicity. Diffusion of either species alone is dissipative on this graph; that does not by itself ensure stability of the coupled reacting state.
uniform_stability: Derive the unique positive spatially uniform stationary state, its local reaction Jacobian and the complete mode generator J0-q*diag(DX,DY) for each actual graph eigenvalueq. For B in[1.7,2], compare the first loss of full uniform-state linear asymptotic stability with the hypothetical well-mixed Hopf threshold. Also derive the minimum stationary threshold if positive q could vary continuously, and decide whether that continuum minimizing q is physically available on this fixed four-compartment graph. Retain actual PolynomialRoots for the COMPLETE characteristic polynomial of each distinct graph-mode generator at the finite first threshold; a repeated spatial eigenvalue must not be collapsed when counting physical modes.
nonlinear_pattern_family: Focus on the EXACT alternating invariant subspace X1=X3=u_plus,X2=X4=u_minus,Y1=Y3=v_plus,Y2=Y4=v_minus. Define positive canonical amplitude a=(u_plus-u_minus)/2>0; the one-compartment translation is the same pattern family, not a distinct physical branch. Derive all positive stationary alternating branches over B in[1.7,2], including the uniform branch, from the original steady equations. Exclude extraneous roots, nonpositive concentrations and a=0 before claiming a nonzero solution. Derive the leading a^2 versus B-B_T relation and the local center-manifold normal form dot(a)=c*(B-B_T)*a-g*a^3+higher-order terms at first onset, where a is this PHYSICAL X half-difference; parameter/slaving corrections beyond the stated order do not change c or g. Decide supercriticality and local stability without inferring global dynamics from a cubic truncation.
full_secondary_stability: Determine the COMPLETE open B interval, inside[1.7,2], where the nonzero alternating branch is linearly asymptotically stable in the FULL eight-dimensional system. Include the endpoint behavior and determine the first secondary loss of stability, its positive amplitude and whether the critical mode is oscillatory or stationary and belongs to the alternating invariant subspace. Derive a full invariant-mode factorization or equivalent complete Hurwitz certificate over the continuous branch, not a grid. If eliminating square roots introduces extra roots, retain an actual PolynomialRoots call for the complete resulting boundary polynomial and audit all original signs/domains before selecting a critical root. Positivity and validity of both the invariant and transverse sectors must be established throughout the claimed interval. Stability restricted to the alternating subspace alone is not sufficient.
actual_full_state_audits: At B=1.751 and1.77, report the canonical positive alternating stationary concentration rows in compartment order, number of positive-real-part and zero-real-part eigenmodes with algebraic multiplicity, and the largest real part. Retain actual PolynomialRoots of EACH complete degree8characteristic polynomial of the ACTUAL full interleaved Jacobian. At B=1.77 independently retain an actual MatrixExponential for10times that full8x8Jacobian, then an actual MatrixMultiply of its returned exponential by column perturbation[1,0,0,0,-1,0,0,0]^T. Report the resulting linearized time10response in the declared order and verify why this perturbation can expose a mode hidden by an alternating-subspace simulation. This is the tangent response to an infinitesimal perturbation, not an asserted finite-amplitude nonlinear trajectory.
scope: The family and stability claims concern the alternating branch and full infinitesimal perturbations only. No requirement to enumerate every other nonuniform equilibrium or attractor is imposed, and instability of this branch cannot prove that every other pattern is unstable or absent. Distinguish finite graph modes, an infinite-continuum comparison, a local center manifold, full transverse stability and chemical equilibrium.

interpretation_proposals.A: A continuum dispersion minimum can predict a lower threshold than any mode supported by a small fixed reactor network.
interpretation_proposals.B: Stability of the isolated chemical Jacobian and each isolated diffusion operator guarantees stability after coupling them.
interpretation_proposals.C: A stable pattern just beyond its primary supercritical onset can lose stability before the uniform state reaches the next mode threshold.
interpretation_proposals.D: A simulation restricted to an invariant alternating family can certify stability against every spatial perturbation.
interpretation_proposals.E: The multiplicity and support of transverse modes matter when testing whether a designed chemical pattern can persist.
interpretation_proposals.F: A secondary loss of stability of this family proves that no other stable nonuniform attractor exists.
interpretation_proposals.G: A stationary pattern in this driven irreversible chemostat must be an equilibrium free-energy minimum.
interpretation_proposals.H: A finite-time matrix exponential audits linearized perturbation dynamics and cannot by itself establish global nonlinear attractor selection.

reporting: Use the public answer schema. Rates/control/amplitudes/eigenvalues/responses numeric absolute tolerance1e-7; strict asymptotic stability, zero modes, threshold endpoint inclusion, mode multiplicity and claims are exact. Graph spectra include multiplicity. State rows use compartments1through4, each[X,Y], with a>0choosing largerXat1and3. The uniform-state functional fields use strings1andB. Justifications, continuous-domain certificates and full actual root/exponential observations remain in the trajectory.

primary_context.title: Symmetry Breaking Instabilities in Dissipative Systems.II
primary_context.role: Primary context for driven autocatalytic symmetry-breaking kinetics. This task has its own four-compartment geometry, exact transport oracle, nonlinear branch and stability parameters; it reproduces no article figures/text/data.
